props.title: Will Russia use a nuclear weapon in Ukraine before December 31, 2025?
props.shortTitle: Will Russia use a nuke on Ukraine in 2025?
props.details:
According to former US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, President Biden considered the threat of Russia using nuclear weapons against Ukraine to be real. Experts believe that this fear of nuclear escalation has contributed to the decisions to limit the supply of weapons to Ukraine.

Resolution

This question will resolve as Yes if Russia detonates a nuclear weapon on, under or over the internationally recognized territory of Ukraine before December 31.
